source_metadata.organization: Central Water Commission (CWC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Govt. of India
source_metadata.title: River Water Level Tiers, Flood Forecasting Stages and Hydro-Observation Protocols

Normal_Flood_Situation.criteria: River stage is below Warning Level (WL).
Normal_Flood_Situation.operational_meaning: River within normal embankments; routine gauge reading.

Above_Normal_Flood_Situation.criteria: River stage >= Warning Level (WL) and < Danger Level (DL).
Above_Normal_Flood_Situation.operational_meaning: Water reaching floodplain fringes; alert district authorities to restrict riverbank access and prepare relief camps.

Severe_Flood_Situation.criteria: River stage >= Danger Level (DL) and < Highest Flood Level (HFL).
Severe_Flood_Situation.operational_meaning: Active bank overflow, inundation of adjacent residential and agricultural settlements. Immediate rescue team deployment.

Extreme_Flood_Situation.operational_meaning: All-time record flood stage. CWC issues mandatory 'Red Bulletin' hourly. Massive evacuation and catastrophic breach protocols activated.

rate_of_rise_guidelines.rapid_rise: 5 to 20 cm/hour (flashy watershed response, expedited extraction)
rate_of_rise_guidelines.flash_rise: > 20 cm/hour (dam gate release or cloudburst, immediate siren escalation, vertical evacuation only)
